notes.title: bug fix
notes.notes:
Fix to reported game freeze.
Fix to oversight on my part that allowed players to re-enter final boss room postgame.

notes.title: Update
notes.notes: It seems my last round of updates did not go through.  I should really playtest the steam version instead of my constantly evolving personal version.  Included in the update is everything posted in the last update notes, a temporary workaround for an issue where players may become stuck in the pit stage, and anything I was working on between the last update and this emergency update.  I will be playtesting the steam version today to verify everything is now working as intended.

notes.title: Anniversary Update, Part 2
notes.notes:
Surprise!  Here's another update in celebration of the first anniversary of the Sorrows End release.  

Major update to menu backgrounds.
Updated animation for skill "Meteor".
Several additional visual updates.
Added additional options for stat point distribution to further customize character development.
Removed unintended remnants of "Scene Viewer" testing phase.


Coming Soon:

Postgame content.  It will happen.

notes.title: Anniversary Update
notes.notes:
Sorrows End turned 1 year old today!  To celebrate, a Scene Viewer has been added to the Rumio 
restaurant.  New games will unlock the scenes as they are viewed.  Old save files need only enter the most recent story map to unlock everything to that point.

Removed the battle status overlay for current difficulty settings from enemies.
Various movement bug fixes.

notes.title: Large Update.
notes.notes:
Added 5 new difficulty settings, changeable with a new Key Item "Bravery Button".  New games will get the item automatically, existing games can claim theirs from a new NPC in the Rumio Restaurant.  Hard and Master difficulty will reward more credits when killing bosses.

Extended "Campsite" cutscene.

Reworked final weapons to replace "Attack" with specialized skills, all of which are "Cannot Miss".

Frostville blacksmith can now upgrade Flail of Radiance and Tenshi's Quill to their final forms.

Several map updates, including fixes to unintended wall climbing areas.


Planned future updates to include further post-game content and a scene viewer (if I can ever make it work right.)

notes.title: Update.
notes.notes:
Added several filler npc's and visual update to Jesagris castle interior.
Added names to appear when entering maps.
Increased damage output for several of Hok's skills.
Judgement skill will now correctly perform as a "Cannot miss" skill.
Updated menu windows to have consistently colored HP, MP, TP gauges.
Updated item vendors in Camlet and Resistance camp.

notes.title: Arena Update
notes.notes:
Added two new final boss caliber tier 3 challenges to the Arena for those who made the good end critical choice.  Save first folks!
Taught arena vendor how to count, fixing an exploit that would allow one to purchase goods indefinitely if their lifetime count of arena coins was high enough.
Added "Cannot miss" tag to several mediocre skills reworked to ignore counter, evasion, and reflection to increase their usefulness.
Limited number of free items from Frostville Mayor 2nd quest to make more available when 
party stock is zero only.
Minor graphical fixes.


I hope everyone is enjoying my game!  This will likely be the last update for a while.  Bug reports will still be handled promptly.

Planned but yet unscheduled updates include:  Additional post game content.  Map improvements.

notes.title: hotfix
notes.notes: Correct fix for Judgement skill.  Increased Judgement skill damage output.  Reduction of hidden item hint vendor gold cost.

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
Removed TP cost from Judgement skill introduced in last update.  Rebalanced early game enemy
AI per player feedback.  Minor graphical fixes.

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.notes: All reported bugs fixed, removal of unintended leftovers from pre release.
